baidu/ernie-5.0-thinking-preview.reason: Baidu's ERNIE 5.0 Thinking Preview (released 2025-11-13, natively omni-modal, per Artificial Analysis and coverage); the index has only ERNIE 4.5 models and no ERNIE 5.0 entry.

deepseek/deepseek-v3.2-exp.reason: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp (Sep 2025, DeepSeek Sparse Attention, built on V3.1-Terminus) is a separate experimental checkpoint from the Dec 2025 V3.2 release; the index has no exp entry, so defer rather than link to deepseek/deepseek-v3.2.

volcengine/doubao-seed-code.reason: Volcengine's Doubao-Seed-Code, ByteDance's first Doubao programming model (released 2025-11-11 per Volcengine/36kr coverage); the index has only the later Seed 2.0 Code (2026-02-14), a different generation.
